results.matched_title: Missing Ownership Check for Database Read Operations

baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for '/current' route
baseline_findings.description: The '/current' route is exposed without any authentication checks. This allows unauthenticated users to access the endpoint, which could potentially expose sensitive user information.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., validateToken) was found on this function or its callers. The route is exposed without any control, making it accessible to unauthenticated users.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication middleware (e.g., validateToken) to the '/current' route to ensure only authenticated users can access it.

baseline_findings.title: Missing ownership enforcement for database read operations
baseline_findings.description: The function does not enforce ownership when reading contacts. Any authenticated user can access any contact, regardless of the owner.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No ownership check is present in the shown evidence or callers. Each operation reads a contact without verifying that the requesting user owns it.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an ownership check to ensure that only the owner of a contact can read it. This can be done by comparing `req.user.id` with `contact.user_id` before returning the contact data.

baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for user registration
baseline_findings.description: The function `registerUser` does not perform any authentication checks before allowing a new user to register. This exposes the system to unauthorized access, as anyone can create an account without proper credentials.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., isLoggedIn, requireAuth) is present in the function or its callers. The operation requires authentication to ensure that only authorized users can register new accounts.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check before allowing a user to register. This could involve checking if the user is already logged in or requiring them to provide valid credentials.
